generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of kppp-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
For Details Refer Tender Notification And Conditions In The Bid Documents.
All materials should be in good quality as per specification, quality certificate for the same should be obtained from the concerned authority at their own cost.

All the scanned documents pertaining to bidder to be uploaded shall be in original and same originals should be produced to the Executive Engineer (at the time of Technical Bid Opening) who reserves right to verify the original documents before approval.
To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer should give all details and documents as per Technical and Financial bid attached to this tender.
All the materials to be utilised for the work must be tested in PRED labs/ 3rd Party Consultant and Quality control test reports must be enclosed to the bills mandatorily.
If any date in the tender time table is government holiday, next working date will be considered
Executive Engineer PRED Belgaum has authority to accept or reject any tender without assigning reason
Tenderer must mandatorily submit his present accurate postal address and phone number in a signed letterhead.
The tender may be cancelled at any stage without assigning any reason
Tenderers must have valid PRED/PWD registration and must submit PRED/PWD registration copy
Any objection regarding the tender must be submitted directly to Executive Engineer , not in inward.
For interpretations of clauses, conditions, spelling mistakes, etc. decision of Executive Engineer, PRED, Belgaum is final.

Successful bidder submitting bids below the amount put to tender will be regularized to submit the difference amount in the form of FDR/BG/SD/Pledge on the name of EE PRED Belagavi within 15 days from the date of receiving the letter of acceptance. additional security paid for unbalanced tenders Failing which EMD will be forfeited and further action will be taken as per G O No FD PCL 2008 Bangalore Dated 14/10/2008.

As per Government order No. FD 56 PWD cell 2004, Bngalore, 18th Janury 2005, The contractor shall be made responsible for submiting e-bills duly suported the hard copy of detailed measurements of work. using electrinic spreadsheets and making computation thereof. The conctractor shall submit diskette/ CD room in addition the hard copy.

The tenderers must submit the scanned documents in pdf / jpeg form, not in other form and which are should not be corrupted files. If it shows errors while opening the documents the employer is not responsible. Hence the such files will be considerd as un submitted.

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24,2024-25, & 2025-26 achieved in One financial year should be more than financial turnover of Rs. 7.60Lakhs (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only)

The Tenderer shall obtain Similar Nature of Work done certificate will be Considered financial years of 2021-22 to 2025-26 (50% of the Amount Put to Tender) i.e Rs.3.80lakhs in the prescribed format from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer(District Level Officer) and scan the Original Certificate and attach the scanned file to the Bid.

Tenderer must have liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of not less than 30% amount Put to Tender (Credit lines/ letter of credit/ certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc. for three months of Rs.2.28Lakhs (LOC letter should be unconditional format)
THIS WORK IS RANDOMISED AS OTHER WORK.
Single Tender Will Not Be Accepted
Bidder should submit completed work, Work done certificate if in case they submit the workdone certificate as on ongoing work. Such Bidder will be disqualified
Ongoing works: Bidder shall compulsorily submit details of all PHYSICAL ONGOING WORKS on their official letterhead, duly signed & stamped. NIL declaration shall result in disqualification.
Mandatory site visit: Bidder/Contractor shall compulsorily upload a GPS-tagged site photograph showing data, time & location before bidding failure to submit shall result in rejection of the bid.
Related Document: As soon as LOA will be sent to contractor login, within 15days submit back by attaching required document. If failed to attach tender will be cancelled & retendered.
Working methodology: Before finalising L1, the bidder shall submit a work methodology & resource plan for department of screutiny & approval.

itemList.description: Providing and laying in position plain cement concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The  granite/trap/basalt  crushed graded coarse aggregates  and fine aggregates  as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators,  including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machineries, curing,  and all the other  appurtenances  required to complete the work as per technical specifications. (The cost of steel reinforcement & formwork shall be paid separately)  Mix 1:4:8( M5) Using 40 mm and down size graded crushed coarse  aggregates with all lead, lifts, loading & unloading charges including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, equipments, HOM of machinary and other incidental charges required for successfull completion of work etc., complete as per specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer incharge of the work.

Providing and laying Vitrified tiles with thickness 9-10 mm in floor with different sizes with water absorption less than 0.08% and conforming to IS:15622, of approved brand & manufacturer, in all colours and shade, laid with cement based high polymer modified quick set tile adhesive (water based) conforming to IS : 15477, in average 6 mm thickness, including grouting of joints (Payment for grouting of joints to be made separately)with all lead, lifts, loading & unloading charges including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, equipments, HOM of machinary and other incidental charges required for successfull completion of work etc., complete as per specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer incharge of the work.

Demolishing R.B. work manually/by mechanical means including stacking of steel bars and disposal of unserviceable material to the appropriate disposal area as per direction of Engineer-in-charge with all lead, lifts, loading & unloading charges including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, equipments, HOM of machinary and other incidental charges required for successfull completion of work etc., complete as per specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer incharge of the work.

Providing  Brick  work  with  common  burnt  clay  Non  Modular bricks  of  class designation 3.5 in superstructure above plinth level in all shapes and sizes in Cement mortar 1:6 (1 cement : 6 coarse sand)  including cost of all materials, labour, scaffolding and usage charges of machinery & other incidental charges complete as per the direction of engineer incharge of work. with all lead, lifts, loading & unloading charges including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, equipments, HOM of machinary and other incidental charges required for successfull completion of work etc., complete as per specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer incharge of the work.

Providing   20 mm cement plaster of mix :1:6 (1 cement: 6 fine sand) to brick/stone masonary including rounding off corners wherever required smooth rendering, providing and removing scaffolding, including cost of materials, labour, curing complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.with all lead, lifts, loading & unloading charges including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, equipments, HOM of machinary and other incidental charges required for successfull completion of work etc., complete as per specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer incharge of the work.

Finishing walls with Acrylic Smooth exterior paint of required shade :New work (Two coat applied @ 1.67 ltr/10 m² over and including priming coat of exterior primer applied @ 2.20 kg/10 m²)  with paint of approved quality to give an even shade, after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.with all lead, lifts, loading & unloading charges including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, equipments, HOM of machinary and other incidental charges required for successfull completion of work etc., complete as per specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer incharge of the work.

Providing and fixing 1mm thick M.S. sheet door with frame of 40x40x6 mm angle iron and 3 mm M.S. gusset plates at the junctions and corners, all necessary fittings complete, including applying a priming coat of approved steel primer. Using M.S. angels 40x40x6 mm for diagonal braces including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in- Charge with all lead, lifts, loading & unloading charges including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, equipments, HOM of machinary and other incidental charges required for successfull completion of work etc., complete as per specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer incharge of the work.

Providing and fixing  Steel work in built up tubular (round, square or rectangular hollow tubes etc.) trusses etc., including cutting, hoisting, fixing in position and  applying  a  priming  coat  of  approved  steel  primer,  including welding and bolted with special shaped washers etc. complete. Hot finished seamless type tubes  including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in-Charge.with all lead, lifts, loading & unloading charges including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, equipments, HOM of machinary and other incidental charges required for successfull completion of work etc., complete as per specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer incharge of the work.

Providing & fixing corrugated G.S. sheet roofing including vertical / curved surface fixed with polymer coated J or L hooks, bolts and nuts 8 mm diameter with bitumen and G.I. limpet washers or with G.I. limpet washers filled with white lead, including a coat of approved steel primer and two coats of approved paint on overlapping of sheets complete as per design drawings  (up to any pitch in horizontal/ vertical or curved surfaces), excluding the cost of purlins, rafters and trusses and including cutting to size and shape wherever required as per the direction of Engineer in charge 0.63 mm thick with zinc coating not less than 275 g/ m² with all lead, lifts, loading & unloading charges including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, equipments, HOM of machinary and other incidental charges required for successfull completion of work etc., complete as per specifications and as per the directions of the Engineer incharge of the work.
